quest.title: ...It's the Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness!
quest.description: Thanks to everyone (but especially you), the performance venue is ready at last. It's time for the final celebration...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Iridescence Tour Tickets x80, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5

chapter.num: Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness: Glorious Finale
chapter.title: ...It's the Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Thank you both so much! At last, everything on the list is done.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I'm afraid I still have some final preparations to make, but I'll see you tomorrow. Then, the party can begin!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I still have some final preparations to make for the big party.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Compadres, you're here! Hey, serious props to you both. The place looks amazing, even better than I imagined! Hahahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: #Everything looks perfect. We're ready for business. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, you have our thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guys, guys... why so serious? That ain't rock 'n' roll, man.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, look at that! My favorite melon's a fast learner! Also, I hear you're gonna be taking the stage tonight! Itching for a little competition, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Paimon was just joking! ...Gah, seriously, Dvorak? Unbelievable...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Getting cold feet? Don't blame you. I am the reigning champion of The Great Singalong, after all.

choices.text: Oh, Paimon. Backing down from a challenge ain't very rock 'n' roll.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What— Paimon is too rock 'n' roll! Paimon was just being humble!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Then bring it on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon's bringin' it alright! Paimon's bringin' it all the way home! Hmph!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh by the way — did you ever find that dog?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: ...We hit a complete dead-end. Gorou said he didn't know anything, Mamoru and the guys asked around the city, but no luck there either.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: What if it really IS in Tenshukaku? Is that why we can't find it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no, don't go poking around Tenshukaku again... You'll give Kujou Sara a migraine.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Couldn't agree more. If I bother her too much, I'll end up getting struck by lightning...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: So that's why this time, I kept my distance and just threw some paper notes towards Tenshukaku. Hopefully, the Raiden Shogun sees them and hands the dog over.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what? You're still taking a big risk there...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: It looks like Doushin Shikanoin was right. It's probably just a local legend after all.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Let's hope not, 'cause that would really suck! Wish I had more time to look into it, but unfortunately — this guy's got a performance to practice for.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Now don't forget, there's lyrics and music scores in the Jam Zone. So no wussing out tonight!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't get too cocky, Bull-Chucker! We'll see who's rock 'n' roll!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahahahaha! Game on, Mini Melon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon better get some practice in at the Jam Zone soon. No way is Paimon gonna lose to Itto!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: By the way, we invited a ton of people this time, including some people you know. A few have already shown up, and they're asking about you — wanna go say hi?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cool! Yeah, let's go see them! Paimon's curious to find out who you invited.

choices.text: Come on, Paimon. You can beat Itto!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, ya think so? 'Cause Paimon totally thinks so too.

talks.objective: Meet your friends at the celebration

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: This Ms. Hina looks very familiar... Even the outfit...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I was thinking the same thing, Your Excellency. But I just can't put my finger on it...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: She really is the spitting image...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Of who?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gorou! Kokomi! Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Ah, hello, you two! It's been a while!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'm so happy to see you again. I was just asking Shinobu if she knew where you were.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is a nice surprise. Paimon didn't expect to run into you two at an Arataki Gang music festival!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hear that Gorou helped to secure the venue?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Oh, I barely did anything.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: A reader from my That's Life column was asking for advice about it, so I figured I'd help out. Turned out the reader in question was Mr. Arataki Itto.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Her Excellency was also very supportive of the whole thing.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Mm... An international rock 'n' roll music festival sounded like a good way to attract tourists. And it's to bring attention to the plight of living things, right? Seems like a meaningful cause.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Apparently, it has something to do with a dog that was a war hero? Although sadly, probably not a true story. Have either of you... heard anything about that...?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Oh, you know, bits and pieces... Nothing concrete.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Mm... Yeah, no, me neither.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, those sounded suspiciously like prepared answers!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Hehe, probably because we've answered that question before. Mr. Arataki Itto came to ask us about it a while back. We'd certainly love to help, if we can.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Yes, of course... Um, ahem, actually, I was hoping to ask for your opinion on something.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, what is it?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Does Ms. Hina look familiar to you at all? I have this strange feeling like I've seen her somewhere before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Umm...

choices.text: I feel like I've met her before... but...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: But you don't remember where?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Eh, she probably just looks similar to someone you know. Like how {NICKNAME} looks similar to {M#his}{F#her} {M#sister}{F#brother}! There's no mystery here. Don't overthink it.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: I see... That does make sense...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's get outta here...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Hmm. Maybe it's just me...

talks.objective: Meet your friends at the celebration

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: You're a real trooper, Yoimiya! This must be one of the furthest places you've ever delivered to.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I promised Itto that I'd supply fireworks for his festival. I wasn't about to go back on my word.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Thoma, Yoimiya!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! Cool, you're here too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's been too long!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Haha, looks I owe the Arataki Gang a huge thank-you. If they weren't putting on this event, who knows when I would've gotten to see you next.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: You hear that? In case it was too subtle for you — Thoma's complaining that you guys never make time to come and visit your old pals.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: That's true. Obviously, traveling's very important to you, but you gotta take a break every once in a while. Just remember that you've got friends out there who'd love nothing more than the chance to make you feel looked after.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you both. That means a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Of course! Ooh, I heard this really cool thing, I gotta share with you guys.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: So Itto says that the theme of this music festival comes from a story about a dog that saved animals in the warzone. How amazing is that!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: What do you know about this dog, Thoma? Everyone knows how well-connected you are.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Heh, for once... not much, I'm afraid. I guess my connections are one key canine short.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: But assuming this really happened, I feel like Watatsumi Island would've had to be involved.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: This is a dog who managed to sneak in and out of a warzone, repeatedly, without leaving a trail for anyone to follow. Whatever the case, it would've needed someone to help cover its tracks.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: As far as I know, the Shogun's Army doesn't do that kind of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're saying it was the Sangonomiya troops? They had a specially trained dog for rescuing critters from the battlefield?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Sounds kinda far-fetched if you ask me... Do we really think Sangonomiya's forces had enough manpower to fight a full-scale war and run a... what, a canine wildlife rescue operation on the side?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, well if wasn't Sangonomiya's side, it must have been the Shogunate!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I doubt they had the manpower either...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Right. So in my view, it's more likely that Mr. Dvorak simply made the story up as something to capture people's imaginations.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I mean, he's an artist, right? Isn't rock music about expressing things we don't fully understand?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Kinda like fireworks, in a way. Don't question it, just feel it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Yeah, that sort of makes sense. That makes you an artist too, Yoimiya! Fireworks are your art.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Heehee, I'll take it! And on that note — boy, do I have an art show for you tonight! Make sure you don't miss it!

talks.objective: Meet your friends at the celebration

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Hey, there you are! I sent you some letters a few days ago, have they shown up yet?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooooh! Does this mean you've figured it out?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: I've made some progress, but I'm still missing the final piece of the puzzle.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So. What did you learn?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: I don't have anything conclusive yet, but I have a hunch that it involved both the Yashiro Commission and Sangonomiya.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? You mean like... in cahoots? During the war!?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Shhh... Like I said, it's just a hunch. Let's not get carried away.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Anyway, I've written to the station, and they shouldn't take too long to get back to me. Yoriki Owada should be able to help find what I need.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: In the meantime, you'll just have to be patient.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: I would have gone back to the station to look into it myself, but I knew Itto was performing tonight and I didn't wanna miss it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know who else is performing tonight? Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Oh, wow! Sounds like I'm in for a real treat. I definitely picked the right place to be tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Will the Traveler's long-serving "Voice" finally graduate from speech to song in a triumphant victory over the oni rocker of Hanamizaka?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They don't call her "Flying Rock 'N' Roll Fuel" for nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! I'll be awaiting with bated breath!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cut it out, both of you! No more stupid nicknames!

talks.objective: Go to the Jam Zone to look for Dvorak

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Mr. Dvorak! You're still here.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Sure am. I've been checking over the equipment, scores, and lyric sheets to make sure everything's ready for tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Shinobu was telling me how popular light novels are here in Inazuma. So I've tweaked the melody and lyrics for a more Arataki Gang feel with a light novel twist.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Light novels plus rock music, so... light rock!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Hahaha. I actually didn't change too much — just took out the dog and made it about Onikabuto instead. Should be more up Itto's alley.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: This event couldn't have happened without him. It's my way of showing him some appreciation, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whaaat? You got rid of the dog? But... wasn't that the whole inspiration behind the festival?

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Yes, but that's all it was. The initial inspiration. Doesn't matter if we change it to an Onikabuto, or you, or me, or anything else. It's the spirit of it that counts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Spirit? What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Umm... The spirit of rock 'n' roll?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Okay, shoulda seen that coming.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you think people have been getting too hyper-focused on the dog story?

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Hehe, it's all about the music, my friends. Just enjoy the music, that's all that matters.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fair enough... Alright, well speaking of enjoying music, is it alright if Paimon goes first?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's gotta get practicing, or Bull-Chucker's gonna hog the spotlight tonight!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: By all means, be my guest! I knew you'd come around to the idea of going on stage.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Here's the music score and lyrics. I can't wait to see this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, let's see now, what's this song called...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "I Got Reincarnated as an Onikabuto... And Flipped the World Upside Down"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What sort of song title is that? Is this supposed to be rock 'n' roll?

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Soft rock, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I gotta see these lyrics...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Nope, no peeking, {NICKNAME}! You can hear them tonight when Paimon sings the song!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's gonna rock so hard, Bull-Chucker won't know what hit him!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The time flies by, and night soon falls...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Music lovers take turns showcasing their talent on the stage.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Whoops and cheers ring out as the crowd grows louder and the atmosphere gets wilder.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Before you know it, the moment has arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Ladies and gentlemen!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Tonight is a night to celebrate, and I trust you're all having a wonderful time!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: It's been a non-stop rock 'n' roll ride this evening, and we're almost at the end. But first, it is my huge honor to invite two very special guests to the stage...

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: The illustrious Mr. Arataki Itto!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: And Ms. Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: The two of them will be performing a brand-new song written specially for tonight's event. It's called:

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: "I Got Reincarnated as an Onikabuto... And Flipped the World Upside Down"!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Take it away!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Ladies and gentlemen!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Tonight is a night to celebrate, and I trust you're all having a wonderful time!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: It's been a non-stop rock 'n' roll ride this evening, and we're almost at the end. But first, it is my huge honor to invite two very special guests to the stage...

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: The illustrious Mr. Arataki Itto!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: And Ms. Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: The two of them will be performing a brand-new song written specially for tonight's event. It's called:

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: "I Got Reincarnated as an Onikabuto... And Flipped the World Upside Down"!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Take it away!

talks.objective: At the end of an endless night of rock 'n' roll...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After an exhilarating song to end the night, many people begin to leave...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: But you and your friends approach the stage to congratulate the two rockstars...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: So that's rock music, huh? It's a little different than I imagined.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Really? It's different from what I'd heard before... Could be a relatively new genre of rock, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So, how'd you like my performance? Did I dominate this lil' melon here or what? Hahahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, Bull-Chucker! You got owned and you know it!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh, stop it, you two. I think both of you were sensational!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Hear, hear! Really mind-blowing stuff, guys.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I call it a draw. You're very evenly matched.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, you think? Okay, well what about you, my compadre? Who do you think is the most rock 'n' roll?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahahahaha! That's right, compadre you tell 'em. Behold the majesty of the Rock 'N' Roll King of Hanamizaka!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Argh! Traitor! That's it, Paimon's not talking to you for the next minute!

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Haha, let's not argue anymore, shall we? Itto and Paimon, you both gave incredibly moving performances...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: I owe you all an enormous debt of gratitude. Without your help, this music festival never would've happened.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Don't mention it, Jack-Attack! Hey, if we hadn't met, I wouldn't even know what the spirit of rock 'n' roll means!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: The spirit of rock 'n' roll? So, what does it mean? What does it mean for rock music to have a "spirit"?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: It means you rock up, rock out, roll the dice, and roll with the punches! Just like me and Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's obviously not what it means... Mr. Dvorak, could you please give us the official definition? Someone needs to take this guy down a peg.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Hehe, an official definition? I don't know that one exists... It's an emotional experience. As though you're hearing your own story speak to you through the music.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Funny you should say that... I was just thinking that the spirit of rock 'n' roll is... well, like the Onikabuto in the song: Having the courage to grab life by the horns and survive against all the odds.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Guess I have a better sense rock 'n' roll than I thought! Haha.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What about you, Yoimiya?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, well... I thought it was gonna be all about that dog, but then the song didn't even mention it, so...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Was that supposed to be symbolic...? Like, if the dog didn't exist, maybe the injured animals didn't, either...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: If there were no injured animals, that means there was no war, which means... the world is at peace.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! So for Yoimiya, the rock 'n' roll spirit is all about world peace!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Shinobu? What about you?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Me? Uh, I hadn't given it all that much thought. I was mostly worrying about whether those paper notes Boss threw into Tenshukaku are going to get him in trouble with the Tenryou Commission...

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Haha! That must mean that for Shinobu, the rock 'n' roll spirit is about keeping the Arataki Gang safe.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Shinobu, seriously, you've got nothing to worry about. If the Raiden Shogun had seen any of those notes, she'd have come to join the party!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon agrees that you don't need to worry. Otherwise, Heizou definitely would've arrested Itto by now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... Where is that guy, anyway? And where did Kokomi and Gorou go?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Oh, Doushin Shikanoin had to run back to the station, so he didn't get the chance to say goodbye to you guys. But he did leave something for you. It's over there.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: As for the other two, they couldn't stick around because they had a government meeting to get to. They did ask me to pass on their regards, though.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: The fact that these busy people all made time to attend the party is telling. Clearly, Itto wasn't exaggerating about the stature of the Arataki Gang.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Itto, what can I say... It's truly been an honor to work with you.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: #Hahahahaha! Well, Jack-Attack, I can't take all the credit — let's not forget {NICKNAME}'s part in all this!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: #A lot of people only showed up because they knew {M#he'd}{F#she'd} be here. If we do this again, we gotta make sure we find a way to get {M#him}{F#her} on stage.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: How's that sound, compadre? Get that rock 'n' roll spirit ready, 'cause next time, it'll be your turn to rock our collective socks off!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehehe, {NICKNAME}'s always got Paimon's back! Take that, Bull-Chucker! Hah!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: #Huh? Oh, my gullible little melon. You don't really believe that do you? {M#He}{F#She} just didn't wanna hurt your feelings!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Really? Do you really think that?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah, fine... My compadre wouldn't lie to me. I can handle the truth...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: *sigh*... Rock on, Mini Melon... Rock on.

choices.text: Anyway, what nice weather we've been having lately!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey, don't try to change the subject!

talks.objective: At the end of an endless night of rock 'n' roll...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Your Excellency, I believe the Tenryou Commission detective has—

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it, Gorou. The Puppy Union was a joint venture between us and the Yashiro Commission. If we can maintain secrecy, then all the better for it. But that was never the main goal.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: We saved some lives, and that's what matters.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I was more worried about the potential impact on your reputation, Your Excellency... After all, some of the lives we saved belonged to the Shogunate...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: If someone with an agenda finds out, it could cause an uproar...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Don't worry. There might be a way to make it work out in our favor.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Really? How?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Times have changed. We and Narukami Island are supposed to be working together now.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: So it's not necessarily a bad thing if people discover that we were already cooperating with the Yashiro Commission even during the war.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Gorou, if you want my opinion, you should be more concerned about Ms. Hina than you are about this.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Ms. Hina? What makes you say that?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I hear she works for That's Life magazine as well. She's young, popular, pretty...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: And she seems to be just as good at offering comfort to people in need as you are. So it looks like you have some competition.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Ahem... Understood, Your Excellency! I will work hard to stay ahead of the competition!

talks.objective: At the end of an endless night of rock 'n' roll...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I learned something new today... I never knew that the Hydro nation's rock music had the power to stir up lightning.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Miko... A few days ago, some strange paper notes flew into Tenshukaku, demanding that I "hand over the dog"... So I am here to see what on earth it was all about.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Haha, I just assumed you must've gotten yourself a pet puppy.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: As it happens, I also received an invitation letter via Sara.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I've never heard the name "Arataki" before... But they must be one of my subjects, and so I thought, why not grant them their wish?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Ah... so you came here to make a little oni's wish come true, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: So tell me, how do you plan to respond to the Fontainian musician? It sounded to me like his music was commenting on the war...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: The war...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I'm not sure we can give him the answer he would hope for.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: But if nothing else, I know that we must avoid another war at all costs. The people cannot be made to suffer like that again.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: But what if the bigger war comes to pass? What then?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: If it cannot be avoided, then...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: ...I will have no choice but to fight.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Well, if that day comes...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I'm sure that everyone here tonight will fight by your side.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: #Hey {NICKNAME}. Some of your friends are here, wanna go say hi?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Who could it be...?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Sounds like you know a few things about art yourself, Thoma.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Art? Me? ...Does knitting sweaters count?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Absolutely! Knitting is totally an art form!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Just... not a very rock 'n' roll one, I guess. I don't think I'll be doing any knitting tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Not with that attitude! You could, uh... knit sweaters with "Rock 'N' Roll" in big letters! Then get everyone to wear them!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Hmm, good idea! I'll look into it next time.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Hmm, what if Madam Kujou Sara's the one who got my letter... No, surely she wouldn't intentionally ignore it?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The time flies by, and night soon falls...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Music lovers take turns showcasing their talent on the stage.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Whoops and cheers ring out as the crowd grows louder and the atmosphere gets wilder.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Before you know it, the moment has arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After an exhilarating song to end the night, many people begin to leave...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: But you and your friends approach the stage to congratulate the two rockstars...
